title.zh-CN: 多年多饮多尿，近3天呕吐 · 13岁男孩
title.en: Years of thirst and heavy urination, now vomiting · 13-year-old boy

summary.zh-CN: 13岁男孩七年来喝水多、尿也多，这次因呕吐 3 天、吃不下东西住院；急性期过后，他仍然口渴，这还需要一个解释。
summary.en: A 13-year-old who has drunk and passed large volumes for seven years is admitted after three days of vomiting and not eating; once the acute phase is over, his continuing thirst still needs explaining.

notes.zh-CN: 依据一篇已发表的单例病例报告改编。1.1.0版依据1.0.0版已记录的事实重写：13岁男孩，体重27 kg；多饮多尿7年（每日饮水约4200–6000 mL，尿量相近、色清，偶有遗尿），曾考虑精神性多饮或尿崩症，不规律服用中药和加压素，效果不佳；近3天非喷射性呕吐、进食即吐、不能进食、精神变差；否认头部外伤、头痛、呕吐和昏迷史；足月顺产，生长、智力与同龄儿相仿；父母体健，父母及祖辈非近亲婚配；入院查体（神志清、精神萎靡、极消瘦、皮肤黏膜干燥、弹性差、呼吸深长、末梢凉，心率102次/分，血压95/60 mmHg）；血糖、尿糖和尿酮体、pH、HCO₃⁻、阴离子间隙、钠、钾，GAD和IAA阴性；血糖稳定后每日饮水4700–5800 mL、尿比重1.000–1.005、双肾积水、输尿管扩张、排尿困难、视神经萎缩、高频感音神经性听力下降，加压素反应差；报告的临床诊断、胰岛素和氢氯噻嗪治疗、约2周出院和一年内两次随访稳定。这些事实尚未对照原文全文核对。患者姓名为化名，医院和日历日期已去除，时间以呕吐第几天、住院约几周等相对时间表示。陪同家属、全部对话、阶段、决策、处置选项、评分和教学要点为教学设计；1.0.0未记录的内容保持未知。1.0.0称动态试验数据和基因结果“未给出”，本版改为“本病例没有记录”，不再对原文作出断言。1.0.0教学文字中提到的“旧文常规碳酸氢钠”“禁水试验”和“肾性尿崩”标签未作为患者事实写入，列为待核实。体重27 kg与“生长与同龄儿相仿”之间的出入照原样保留。
notes.en: Adapted from one published single-case report. Version 1.1.0 is re-authored from the facts version 1.0.0 records: a 13-year-old boy weighing 27 kg; seven years of polydipsia and polyuria (about 4,200–6,000 mL a day drunk with a similar volume of clear urine, occasional enuresis), once thought to be psychogenic polydipsia or diabetes insipidus and treated irregularly with herbal medicine and vasopressin without benefit; three days of non-projectile vomiting after meals, unable to eat, increasingly listless; previous head injury, headache, vomiting and coma denied; term vaginal birth, growth and intelligence comparable to peers; healthy parents, no consanguinity in the parents' or grandparents' generation; the admission examination (alert but listless, very thin, dry skin and mucous membranes, poor turgor, deep breathing, cool peripheries, heart rate 102/min, blood pressure 95/60 mmHg); glucose, urine glucose and ketones, pH, bicarbonate, anion gap, sodium, potassium, negative GAD and IAA antibodies; after the glucose settled, an intake of 4,700–5,800 mL a day, urine specific gravity 1.000–1.005, bilateral hydronephrosis, ureteric dilatation, voiding difficulty, optic atrophy, high-frequency sensorineural hearing loss and a poor response to vasopressin; the report's clinical diagnosis, insulin and hydrochlorothiazide, discharge at about two weeks and two stable follow-up visits within a year. These facts have not yet been checked against the full article. The patient's name is a pseudonym; hospitals and calendar dates are removed and times are relative (day of vomiting, weeks in hospital). The relative, all dialogue, the phases, decisions, management options, scoring and teaching points are teaching design; what 1.0.0 does not record stays unknown. Version 1.0.0 said the dynamic test data and genetic results were “not given”; this version says this case does not record them, without a claim about the article. The “historical routine bicarbonate”, “deprivation testing” and “nephrogenic” label mentioned in 1.0.0's teaching text are not written in as patient facts and are listed to verify. The tension between the weight of 27 kg and “growth comparable to peers” is kept as recorded.

notes.en: AI-assisted teaching design with an editorial review against the cited guidance. The patient facts are those extracted from the published report for version 1.0.0; they have not yet been checked against the full source article. The case is not yet reviewed by a licensed clinician.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例回看，仅供临床教育，不用于个体诊疗或自行用药。病程和结果均来自原报告，不模拟未记录的生理变化。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for clinical education, not for individual care or self-medication. The course and results come from the report; unrecorded physiological changes are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 根据血糖、尿酮体和酸碱结果诊断糖尿病酮症酸中毒，并按pH与HCO₃⁻中较重的一项分级（ISPAD 2022：pH＜7.1或HCO₃⁻＜5 mmol/L为重度），同时计算按血糖校正的血钠和有效渗透压。
learningOutcomes.en: Diagnose diabetic ketoacidosis from glucose, ketones and acid–base values and grade it by the worse of pH and bicarbonate (ISPAD 2022: severe if pH < 7.1 or bicarbonate < 5 mmol/L), working out the glucose-corrected sodium and the effective osmolality.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 安全开始儿童DKA的治疗：0.9%氯化钠10 mL/kg于30分钟输入，余下的累积损失加维持量在48小时内补足并加氯化钾40 mmol/L，补液1小时以上后开始静脉胰岛素0.05–0.1 U/kg/h，不推注、不用碳酸氢钠（NICE NG18 2020年更新；BSPED 2021；ISPAD 2022）。
learningOutcomes.en: Start paediatric DKA treatment safely: 0.9% sodium chloride 10 mL/kg over 30 minutes, the remaining deficit plus maintenance over 48 hours with potassium chloride 40 mmol/L, and IV insulin 0.05–0.1 unit/kg/h from at least an hour after the fluids, with no bolus and no bicarbonate (NICE NG18 2020 update; BSPED 2021; ISPAD 2022).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 监测脑水肿：说出本例就诊时的危险因素（重度酸中毒、可能的低碳酸血症），每小时观察神经系统，追踪血糖下降时血钠应有的上升，并在床旁备好按体重算好的甘露醇或高渗盐水（ISPAD 2022；Glaser 2001）。
learningOutcomes.en: Watch for cerebral oedema: name this patient's presenting risk factors (severe acidosis, possible hypocapnia), observe neurological status hourly, track the rise in sodium expected as the glucose falls, and keep mannitol or hypertonic saline calculated for his weight at the bedside (ISPAD 2022; Glaser 2001).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别血糖控制后仍持续的低渗性多尿，用配对的血、尿渗透压和住院监护下的禁水–去氨加压素试验加以鉴别，在试验之外绝不限制饮水（Patti 2022）。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise hypotonic polyuria that persists after glucose control, investigate it with paired plasma and urine osmolality and a supervised inpatient water-deprivation–desmopressin test, and never restrict water outside such a test (Patti 2022).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 由16岁前出现的抗体阴性糖尿病和视神经萎缩，加上尿崩症、感音神经性听力下降和尿路扩张，作出Wolfram综合征的临床诊断，并以WFS1基因检测和头颅垂体MRI完善评估（GeneReviews WFS1谱系疾病，2023年更新；ISPAD 2022单基因糖尿病指南）。
learningOutcomes.en: Make a clinical diagnosis of Wolfram syndrome from antibody-negative diabetes and optic atrophy before 16 years, with diabetes insipidus, sensorineural hearing loss and urinary tract dilatation, and complete the work-up with WFS1 testing and brain and pituitary MRI (GeneReviews WFS1 spectrum disorder, updated 2023; ISPAD 2022 monogenic diabetes).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 制定多学科计划：对肾积水伴排尿困难评估膀胱排空并转诊泌尿外科（EAU/ESPU 2020），保证随时饮水并给出应急方案，安排胰岛素自我管理教育、眼科、听力、遗传咨询和心理支持（SID/SIEDP 2025）。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan multidisciplinary care: bladder-emptying assessment and urology referral for hydronephrosis with voiding difficulty (EAU/ESPU 2020), free access to water with an emergency plan, insulin self-management education, ophthalmology, audiology, genetic counselling and psychological support (SID/SIEDP 2025).

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 七年来一直喝水多、尿多，这三天老吐，吃不下东西
chiefComplaint.en: I've been drinking and weeing loads for seven years, and for three days I keep being sick and can't eat

triageNote.zh-CN: 13岁男孩，家属陪同收入儿科病房。多饮多尿 7 年；近 3 天呕吐逐渐加重，进食即吐，精神越来越差。入院时神志清楚、精神萎靡，心率 102 次/分，血压 95/60 mmHg。
triageNote.en: 13-year-old boy admitted to the children's ward with a relative. Seven years of heavy drinking and heavy urination; for 3 days, worsening vomiting after meals and increasingly listless. On admission he is awake but listless, heart rate 102/min, blood pressure 95/60 mmHg.

tags.en: Seven years of thirst and polyuria

personality.zh-CN: 13岁男孩，很瘦，平时话不多。吐了三天、浑身没劲，说话慢、句子短；住院、抽血让他有些害怕，但问到什么都老实回答。急性期过后精神好一些，还是一直口渴。
personality.en: A very thin, quiet 13-year-old. After three days of vomiting he is worn out and talks slowly in short sentences; hospital and blood tests frighten him a little, but he answers honestly whatever he is asked. After the acute phase he is brighter but still thirsty all the time.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 用孩子的日常口语回答，不用医学术语：说“喝水”“尿尿”“吐”；药名只记得“中药”和“加压素”；数字只说病史里有的；不知道的就直说说不上来。
speechStyle.en: Answers in a teenager's everyday words without medical terms — “drinking”, “weeing”, “being sick”; remembers only “herbal medicine” and “vasopressin” as drug names; gives only the numbers in his history; says plainly when he doesn't know.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生，我这几天老吐，吃不下东西，浑身没劲。
openingLine.en: Doctor, I keep being sick these last few days — I can't eat anything and I've got no energy.

concerns.zh-CN: 我是不是得了什么很重的病？
concerns.en: Have I got something really serious?

concerns.zh-CN: 渴得厉害的时候，我还能想喝就喝吗？
concerns.en: When I'm really thirsty, can I still drink whenever I want?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：入院阶段他躺在床上，没精神，说话简短，问一句答一句；家属坐在床边，但病史由他自己回答，被问到私人话题时可以请家属先出去。只说已经透露过的病史，用自己的话说，不增减数字或时间；不提任何检查结果。病例没有记录的事（现在还用不用加压素、肚子疼不疼、现在头疼不疼、体重有没有下降、有没有过敏、看东西和听声音怎么样、家里其他亲戚的病、学校和心情），被问到就说“这个我说不上来，医生”，不要编。病房阶段：比刚来时好些，但还是一直口渴、喝水很多，尿尿费劲。随访阶段：出院后一年复查了两次，医生说稳定。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: on admission he lies in bed, listless, answering briefly and only what is asked; a relative sits at the bedside, but he answers his own history and may ask the relative to step out for private questions. He states only history already revealed, in his own words, without changing numbers or times, and never mentions results. What the case does not record (whether he still uses the vasopressin, tummy pain, a headache now, weight loss, allergies, his sight and hearing, illness in other relatives, school and mood) he answers with “I'm not sure, doctor” — never invented. On the ward: better than on arrival, but still thirsty all the time, drinking a lot, and it is a struggle to pass urine. At follow-up: two check-ups in the year since discharge, and he was told things were stable.

persona.zh-CN: 陪他住院的一位近亲属；具体是哪位亲属本病例没有记录，不要另加设定。看着孩子吐了几天、瘦成这样，很着急，话不多；病史让孩子自己说，医生问起时请医生直接问他；谈到长期计划、基因检测和以后的照顾时会认真听、会提问；不补充病例没有记录的任何事。
persona.en: A close relative staying with him in hospital; which relative is not recorded, so add nothing. Anxious after days of vomiting and seeing him so thin, and says little; leaves the history to him and suggests the doctor ask him directly; listens closely and asks questions when the long-term plan, genetic testing and future care come up; adds nothing the case does not record.

description.zh-CN: 入院当天。七年来他喝水多、尿多；这三天呕吐加重、吃不下东西、精神越来越差。采集病史、查体、完成第一批检查并开始治疗；决策 1 和决策 2 作答、最初的治疗都已开始后，时间推进到急性期之后的病房。
description.en: Day of admission. He has drunk and passed large volumes for seven years; for three days the vomiting has worsened, he cannot eat and he is increasingly listless. Take the history, examine him, complete the first tests and start treatment; once decisions 1 and 2 are answered and the first treatment is under way, time moves on to the ward after the acute phase.

description.zh-CN: 急性期处理之后，他在普通病房，血糖已经平稳（是住院第几天未记录）。他仍然一直口渴、喝水很多。查看出入量和尿液检查，判断尿多的原因；决策 3 作答后，时间推进到进一步评估的结果回报。
description.en: After the acute treatment he is on the general ward and his glucose has settled (which hospital day is not recorded). He is still thirsty all the time and drinking a lot. Review his intake chart and urine tests and work out why he passes so much urine; once decision 3 is answered, time moves on to the results of the further assessments.

description.zh-CN: 多尿的检查以及眼、听力和泌尿系统评估的结果陆续回报（各项检查的先后和日期未记录）。把所有发现放在一起，并与他和家人商定长期计划；决策 4 和决策 5 作答后，报告记录的病程开放。
description.en: The results of the polyuria testing and of the eye, hearing and urinary tract assessments come back (their order and dates are not recorded). Put all the findings together and agree a long-term plan with him and his family; once decisions 4 and 5 are answered, the reported course opens.

text.zh-CN: 报告的诊断：Wolfram综合征（临床诊断，本病例没有基因结果记录），以糖尿病酮症酸中毒起病。多尿的解释依据“对加压素反应差”；由于试验数据没有记录，尿崩症是加压素缺乏还是加压素抵抗仍未得到证实。病程：急救后病情稳定；之后用胰岛素和氢氯噻嗪治疗（方案和剂量未记录）；住院约 2 周出院；一年内两次随访情况稳定（随访时测了哪些指标没有记录）。
text.en: The report's diagnosis: Wolfram syndrome (a clinical diagnosis; no genetic result is recorded in this case), presenting with diabetic ketoacidosis. Its account of the polyuria rests on a “poor response to vasopressin”; with the test data not recorded, whether the diabetes insipidus is due to vasopressin deficiency or resistance remains unproven. Course: he stabilised after emergency treatment; insulin and hydrochlorothiazide followed (regimens and doses not recorded); he was discharged after about two weeks and was stable at two follow-up visits within a year (what was measured at them is not recorded).

source.zh-CN: 报告记录（尚待对照原文核对）：临床诊断Wolfram综合征合并DKA，基因分型和尿崩机制未证实；急救后稳定，后用胰岛素和氢氯噻嗪，约2周出院，一年内两次随访稳定
source.en: Recorded in the report (not yet checked against the full article): a clinical diagnosis of Wolfram syndrome with DKA, genetic subtype and mechanism of the diabetes insipidus unproven; stabilised after emergency care, then insulin and hydrochlorothiazide, discharge at about two weeks, stable at two follow-ups within a year

name.zh-CN: 建立外周静脉通路并采血
name.en: Peripheral IV access and blood sampling

dose.zh-CN: 外周静脉留置针（最好两条），同时采血送检血糖、血气、电解质、肾功能和渗透压。
dose.en: Peripheral cannula (ideally two); take blood at the same time for glucose, gas, electrolytes, renal function and osmolality.

response.zh-CN: 已建立静脉通路并送检。本病例没有记录置管情况，也不模拟其效果。
response.en: IV access in and bloods sent. This case does not record the cannulation and does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 床旁监护心率、血压、呼吸、血氧饱和度和心电图，留意提示血钾异常的T波变化。
dose.en: Bedside monitoring of heart rate, blood pressure, breathing, oxygen saturation and the ECG, watching for T-wave changes of abnormal potassium.

response.zh-CN: 监护已接上。本病例只记录了入院时心率 102 次/分、血压 95/60 mmHg，之后的监护数值没有记录，也不模拟。
response.en: Monitor on. This case records only the admission heart rate of 102/min and blood pressure of 95/60 mmHg; later readings are not recorded or simulated.

dose.zh-CN: 0.9%氯化钠注射液 10 mL/kg 静脉输注，30 分钟输完；复评外周循环，第二次补液前先请上级医生评估；这部分液量从累积损失中扣除。
dose.en: 0.9% sodium chloride 10 mL/kg IV over 30 minutes; reassess his perfusion, discuss with a senior before any second bolus, and subtract the volume from the deficit.

response.zh-CN: 补液已开始。本病例记录他经急救后病情稳定，但没有记录所用液体的种类、液量和速度；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Bolus running. This case records that he stabilised after emergency treatment but not which fluids, volumes or rates were used; it does not simulate the effect.

name.en: Rehydration over 48 hours with potassium chloride

dose.zh-CN: 估计的累积损失加维持量，在48小时内匀速补足（扣除初始补液量）：0.9%氯化钠注射液或平衡晶体液，每升加氯化钾 40 mmol（无尿或高钾时暂不加）；严格记录出入量。
dose.en: The estimated deficit plus maintenance, replaced evenly over 48 hours (less the bolus): 0.9% sodium chloride or a balanced crystalloid with potassium chloride 40 mmol/L (none while anuric or hyperkalaemic); strict fluid balance.

harm.zh-CN: 血钾结果还没看就输含钾液体：如果他血钾高或无尿，补钾很危险。先看血钾——ISPAD 2022对高钾者要等确认有尿后再补钾，血钾正常者在初始扩容后与胰岛素同时开始。
harm.en: Potassium-containing fluid before the potassium is known would be dangerous if he were hyperkalaemic or anuric. Check it first: ISPAD 2022 defers potassium in hyperkalaemia until urine output is documented, and starts it with the insulin, after the first fluid, when the potassium is normal.

response.zh-CN: 已开始。本病例没有记录补液方案、补钾或之后的血钾，不模拟其效果。
response.en: Started. This case does not record the fluid plan, the potassium given or later potassium values, and does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 普通（可溶性）胰岛素 0.05–0.1 U/kg/h 静脉泵入（如 50 单位加 0.9% 氯化钠至 50 mL），在开始补液 1 小时以上后开始，不推注负荷量；按血糖、血酮和酸中毒的变化调整，血糖下降后在补液中加葡萄糖，而不是停胰岛素。
dose.en: Soluble (regular) insulin 0.05–0.1 unit/kg/h IV by syringe pump (for example 50 units made up to 50 mL with 0.9% sodium chloride), started at least an hour after the fluids began, with no loading bolus; adjust to the glucose, ketones and acidosis, and add glucose to the fluids as the glucose falls rather than stopping the insulin.

harm.zh-CN: 还没补液就开胰岛素：脱水的孩子用上胰岛素，葡萄糖、水和钾一起进入细胞，循环血量和血钾可能进一步下降。先给0.9%氯化钠，胰岛素在补液开始1小时以上后再开始（ISPAD 2022；NICE NG18和BSPED 2021为1–2小时）。如果血钾还没看：血钾低时胰岛素要推迟，先补钾（ISPAD 2022）。
harm.en: Insulin before any fluid: in a dehydrated child it drives glucose, water and potassium into cells and can drop the circulating volume and potassium further. Give the 0.9% sodium chloride first and start insulin at least an hour after the fluids began (ISPAD 2022; NICE NG18 and BSPED 2021: 1–2 hours). If the potassium is not yet known: a low potassium means delaying the insulin and replacing potassium first (ISPAD 2022).

response.zh-CN: 胰岛素输注已开始。报告记录他稳定后改用胰岛素治疗，但本病例没有记录急救期胰岛素的用法和剂量；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Insulin infusion running. The report records insulin treatment after he stabilised, but this case does not record how insulin was given in the emergency phase or at what dose; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 静脉推注胰岛素负荷量

dose.zh-CN: 普通胰岛素 0.1 U/kg 静脉推注，随后 0.1 U/kg/h 持续输注。
dose.en: Soluble insulin 0.1 unit/kg as an IV push, then 0.1 unit/kg/h by infusion.

harm.zh-CN: 儿童不推注胰岛素：NICE NG18和BSPED 2021明确不给负荷量，ISPAD 2022把补液第1小时内用胰岛素列为脑水肿的治疗相关危险因素；推注还会使血糖、渗透压和血钾下降过快。改为补液1小时以上后以0.05–0.1 U/kg/h持续输注。
harm.en: No insulin bolus in children: NICE NG18 and BSPED 2021 advise against a loading dose, and ISPAD 2022 lists insulin in the first hour of fluids among the treatment-related risk factors for cerebral oedema; a bolus also drops the glucose, osmolality and potassium too fast. Use an infusion of 0.05–0.1 unit/kg/h from at least an hour after the fluids.

response.zh-CN: 已推注。本病例没有记录推注胰岛素，也不模拟其效果。
response.en: Given. This case does not record an insulin bolus and does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 碳酸氢钠 1–2 mmol/kg 静脉滴注 1 小时，纠正酸中毒。
dose.en: Sodium bicarbonate 1–2 mmol/kg IV over an hour to correct the acidosis.

harm.zh-CN: 不要用：ISPAD 2022只在危及生命的高钾血症，或静脉pH低于6.9且心肌收缩力受损时才考虑碳酸氢钠，这里都没有记录。Glaser 2001（NEJM）发现，在各项治疗中只有碳酸氢钠与儿童DKA脑水肿相关（相对危险度4.2）；它还会使血钾进一步下降，并可能加重脑脊液酸中毒。酸中毒靠补液和胰岛素纠正。
harm.en: Do not give it: ISPAD 2022 keeps bicarbonate for life-threatening hyperkalaemia or venous pH below 6.9 with impaired cardiac contractility, and neither is recorded here. In Glaser 2001 (NEJM) bicarbonate was the only treatment associated with cerebral oedema in children with DKA (relative risk 4.2); it also drives potassium down and can worsen CSF acidosis. Fluids and insulin correct the acidosis.

response.zh-CN: 已给药。本病例没有记录使用碳酸氢钠，也不模拟其效果。
response.en: Given. This case does not record bicarbonate and does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 转入高依赖病房或重症监护病房
name.en: Transfer to high-dependency or intensive care

dose.zh-CN: 转入能每小时观察生命体征和神经系统、有处理经验的高依赖病房或儿科重症监护病房。
dose.en: Transfer to a high-dependency or paediatric intensive care bed with experienced staff and hourly vital-sign and neurological observation.

response.zh-CN: 已转入。本病例没有记录他急性期在哪里接受治疗；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Transferred. This case does not record where he was treated in the acute phase; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 每小时观察与复查计划

dose.zh-CN: 每小时记录生命体征、意识（GCS）和毛细血管血糖，严格记录出入量；每 2–4 小时复查血气、钠和钾，并计算校正钠；床旁备好按体重算好剂量的甘露醇或高渗盐水；出现头痛、心率减慢、血压升高或意识改变立即报告。
dose.en: Hourly vital signs, conscious level (GCS) and capillary glucose with strict fluid balance; repeat gas, sodium and potassium every 2–4 hours with the corrected sodium; mannitol or hypertonic saline calculated for his weight and kept at the bedside; report headache, a slowing heart rate, rising blood pressure or any change in conscious level at once.

response.zh-CN: 计划已执行。本病例没有记录之后的观察数值或复查结果，不模拟。
response.en: Plan in place. This case records no later observations or repeat results and does not simulate them.

name.en: Restrict his drinking to about 2 litres a day

dose.zh-CN: 在病房或回家后把每日饮水限制在约 2 升，帮他“改掉”多喝水的习惯，不另作监测。
dose.en: Limit his drinking to about 2 litres a day on the ward or at home to “break the habit”, without any particular monitoring.

harm.zh-CN: 危险：如果他的肾脏不能浓缩尿液，不管喝多少都会继续排出大量稀释尿，限水会很快造成高钠性脱水。禁水只能作为住院检查，在监测体重、血钠和渗透压并设好终止标准的条件下进行（Patti 2022）；平时必须保证他随时能喝到水。
harm.en: Dangerous: if his kidneys cannot concentrate urine, he keeps passing large volumes of dilute urine whatever he drinks, and restriction quickly causes hypernatraemic dehydration. Water deprivation is a hospital test only, with weight, sodium and osmolality monitored and stopping rules set (Patti 2022); otherwise he must always be able to drink.

response.zh-CN: 已限水。本病例没有记录限水，也不模拟其效果。
response.en: Restriction started. This case does not record fluid restriction and does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 去氨加压素口服或鼻喷，从小剂量开始逐步调整，用药期间监测血钠并给出饮水建议。
dose.en: Desmopressin by mouth or nasal spray, starting low and titrated, with sodium monitoring and advice on drinking.

harm.zh-CN: 在有监护的试验之前用去氨加压素，会干扰诊断；加上他每天大量饮水，可能造成水潴留和低钠血症。只有证实加压素缺乏后才用，并监测血钠（Patti 2022）。
harm.en: Desmopressin before a supervised test confuses the diagnosis, and with his heavy drinking it risks water retention and hyponatraemia. Use it only once vasopressin deficiency is shown, with sodium checks (Patti 2022).

response.zh-CN: 已给药。本病例没有记录这次住院用过去氨加压素（此前不规律用过的“加压素”效果不佳），不模拟其效果。
response.en: Given. This case does not record desmopressin during this admission (the earlier, irregular “vasopressin” did not help much), and does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 按儿童每千克体重剂量口服，配合适度限盐；监测血钠、血钾和血糖。
dose.en: By mouth at the paediatric dose per kilogram, with modest salt restriction; monitor sodium, potassium and glucose.

response.zh-CN: 已开始。报告记录他稳定后用了氢氯噻嗪（剂量和疗效未记录）；本病例不模拟其效果。
response.en: Started. The report records hydrochlorothiazide after he stabilised (dose and effect not recorded); the case does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 评估膀胱排空并转诊小儿泌尿外科
name.en: Bladder-emptying assessment and paediatric urology referral

dose.zh-CN: 超声测排尿后残余尿，查肾功能和尿培养；转诊小儿泌尿外科做尿动力学检查；排空不全时开始清洁间歇导尿（EAU/ESPU 2020）。
dose.en: Ultrasound post-void residual, renal function and a urine culture; paediatric urology referral for urodynamics; clean intermittent catheterisation if he does not empty (EAU/ESPU 2020).

response.zh-CN: 已安排。本病例没有记录残余尿、尿动力学、肾功能或导尿情况，不模拟其效果。
response.en: Arranged. This case does not record a residual volume, urodynamics, renal function or catheterisation, and does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 保证随时饮水并制定应急方案
name.en: Free access to water and an emergency plan

dose.zh-CN: 任何时候都让他想喝就喝；给家庭和学校书面方案：呕吐或不能喝水时尽快就医，静脉补液并监测血钠；随身带病情卡。
dose.en: Let him drink whenever he is thirsty, at all times; a written plan for home and school: if he vomits or cannot drink, he needs prompt medical care with IV fluids and sodium checks; he carries a medical alert card.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 长期胰岛素方案与自我管理教育
name.en: Long-term insulin regimen and self-management education

dose.zh-CN: 稳定后改为皮下基础–餐时胰岛素（或胰岛素泵），学会监测血糖和血酮、处理低血糖，以及生病期间的用药规则。
dose.en: Once stable, subcutaneous basal–bolus insulin (or a pump), with training in glucose and ketone monitoring, treating hypoglycaemia and the sick-day rules.

response.zh-CN: 已开始。报告记录他稳定后使用胰岛素（方案和剂量未记录）；本病例不模拟其效果。
response.en: Started. The report records insulin after he stabilised (regimen and doses not recorded); the case does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 眼科、听力、神经科和心理随访
name.en: Ophthalmology, audiology, neurology and psychology follow-up

dose.zh-CN: 眼科：视力、色觉、视野和光学相干断层扫描；听力：助听评估；神经科和心理科：基线评估，并关注情绪。
dose.en: Ophthalmology: acuity, colour vision, fields and optical coherence tomography; audiology: hearing-aid assessment; neurology and psychology: a baseline assessment, with attention to mood.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 临床遗传会诊与遗传咨询

dose.zh-CN: 征得家长同意和他本人赞同后安排基因检测和遗传咨询：说明检测能回答什么、不能回答什么，必要时为家庭其他成员安排检测。
dose.en: With parental consent and his own assent, arrange genetic testing and counselling: what the test can and cannot answer, and testing for other family members where relevant.

response.zh-CN: 已安排。本病例没有记录基因检测或遗传咨询；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Arranged. This case records no genetic test or counselling; it does not simulate the effect.

title.zh-CN: 问清七年多尿和这三天的变化
title.en: Ask about seven years of polyuria and these three days

hint.zh-CN: 这三天和过去七年有什么不同？以前别人怎么解释、怎么治？有没有头部方面的旧病？家里的情况呢？
hint.en: What is different about these three days compared with the last seven years? How was it explained and treated before? Any old head problems? And the family?

guidance.zh-CN: 到床旁问他本人：这次的呕吐和精神变化、多年来的饮水和尿量、以往的诊断和用药、既往史和家里的情况。
guidance.en: Go to his bedside and ask him: the vomiting and how he has been, his drinking and urine over the years, earlier diagnoses and treatment, past history and family.

title.zh-CN: 床旁评估脱水、呼吸和循环
title.en: Assess his hydration, breathing and circulation

hint.zh-CN: 他脱水有多重？呼吸的样子说明了什么？循环是否稳定？
hint.en: How dehydrated is he, what does his breathing pattern tell you, and how secure is his circulation?

guidance.zh-CN: 看神志和体型，测心率和血压，检查皮肤黏膜、呼吸方式和末梢循环，称体重。
guidance.en: Check his alertness and build, pulse and blood pressure, skin and mouth, breathing pattern and peripheral perfusion, and weigh him.

title.zh-CN: 判断急症并开始最初几小时的治疗
title.en: Recognise the emergency and start the first hours' treatment

hint.zh-CN: 哪些床旁和血液检查最快能告诉你他为什么吐、为什么这样呼吸？用哪个数值定严重程度？治疗时什么必须排在最前面？
hint.en: Which bedside and blood tests will tell you fastest why he is vomiting and breathing like this? Which value decides how severe it is, and what must come first in treatment?

guidance.zh-CN: 建立静脉通路、接上监护，送检血糖、尿常规、血气和电解质；在会诊板作答决策 1 和决策 2，并在床旁开始治疗。
guidance.en: Get IV access and the monitor on; send glucose, urinalysis, gas and electrolytes; answer decisions 1 and 2 on the case board and start treatment at the bedside.

title.zh-CN: 解释血糖平稳后仍然多尿
title.en: Explain the polyuria that outlasts the glucose

hint.zh-CN: 血糖已经平稳，尿为什么还这么多、这么稀？怎样检查才安全？
hint.en: With the glucose settled, why is his urine still so plentiful and so dilute — and how can you test it safely?

guidance.zh-CN: 在护士站查看出入量记录和尿检，在会诊板作答决策 3，并安排检查。
guidance.en: Read the intake chart and urine tests at the nurses' station, answer decision 3 on the case board and arrange the testing.

title.zh-CN: 综合所有发现，制定长期计划
title.en: Bring the findings together and plan for the long term

hint.zh-CN: 哪一个诊断能同时解释所有发现？还缺什么证据？哪些问题现在就要处理？
hint.en: Which single diagnosis explains every finding, what evidence is still missing, and which problems need care now?

guidance.zh-CN: 调阅加压素试验、听力报告和泌尿系影像，查看眼底，作答决策 4 和决策 5，并安排相应处置。
guidance.en: Read the vasopressin test, the hearing report and the urinary tract imaging, examine his fundi, answer decisions 4 and 5 and arrange the care.

title.zh-CN: 对照报告记录的诊治与一年随访
title.en: Compare with the reported treatment and the year of follow-up

hint.zh-CN: 报告当年的处理和你的计划哪里一样、哪里不同？哪些结论还没有证据？
hint.en: Where did the report's management match your plan and where did it differ — and which conclusions still lack evidence?

guidance.zh-CN: 在护士站调阅报告记录的病程与随访。
guidance.en: Read the reported course and follow-up at the nurses' station.

prompt.zh-CN: 这个多饮多尿7年、呕吐3天的13岁男孩：血糖 38.74 mmol/L；尿糖 ++++，尿酮体 ++；pH 7.21，HCO₃⁻ 4.2 mmol/L；钠 116 mmol/L，钾 4.0 mmol/L，阴离子间隙 35.6 mmol/L。怎样判断？
prompt.en: This 13-year-old with seven years of polyuria and three days of vomiting has a glucose of 38.74 mmol/L; urine glucose ++++ and ketones ++; pH 7.21, bicarbonate 4.2 mmol/L; sodium 116 mmol/L, potassium 4.0 mmol/L, anion gap 35.6 mmol/L. What is your assessment?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅血糖、尿常规、血气和电解质的结果。
need.en: Read the glucose, urinalysis, blood gas and electrolyte results first.

text.zh-CN: 重度糖尿病酮症酸中毒：按HCO₃⁻ 4.2 mmol/L定为重度；按血糖校正后血钠约128 mmol/L，低钠是真性的
text.en: Severe diabetic ketoacidosis, graded by the bicarbonate of 4.2 mmol/L; corrected for glucose the sodium is about 128 mmol/L, so the low sodium is real

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。高血糖、酮尿和高阴离子间隙代谢性酸中毒构成DKA；ISPAD 2022按pH或HCO₃⁻中较重的一项分级，HCO₃⁻低于5 mmol/L即为重度。校正钠＝116＋2×［(38.74－5.6)/5.6］≈128 mmol/L，仍然偏低；有效渗透压＝2×116＋38.74≈271 mOsm/kg，并不高。重度酸中毒是脑水肿的危险因素，需要高依赖病房级别的观察。
feedback.en: Right. Hyperglycaemia, ketonuria and a high-anion-gap acidosis make this DKA, and ISPAD 2022 grades by whichever of pH or bicarbonate is worse: a bicarbonate below 5 mmol/L is severe. The corrected sodium, 116 + 2 × [(38.74 − 5.6)/5.6], is about 128 mmol/L — still low; the effective osmolality, 2 × 116 + 38.74, is about 271 mOsm/kg — not raised. Severe acidosis is a risk factor for cerebral oedema and calls for high-dependency observation.

text.zh-CN: 轻度糖尿病酮症酸中毒：pH 7.21高于7.2，按pH只算轻度；血钠低只是高血糖稀释造成的，血糖降下来以后会自己恢复正常
text.en: Mild diabetic ketoacidosis, because the pH of 7.21 is above 7.2; the low sodium is only dilution by the high glucose and will right itself as the glucose falls

feedback.zh-CN: 按ISPAD 2022，pH或HCO₃⁻任一项达到标准即按较重的一级分类：pH 7.21只够轻度，但HCO₃⁻ 4.2 mmol/L已是重度。按血糖校正后血钠约128 mmol/L，低钠不能全用稀释解释，治疗中要追踪校正钠的变化。
feedback.en: ISPAD 2022 grades by pH or bicarbonate, whichever is worse: a pH of 7.21 alone reads as mild, but a bicarbonate of 4.2 mmol/L is severe. Corrected for glucose the sodium is about 128 mmol/L, so dilution does not explain it all, and the corrected sodium needs tracking through treatment.

text.zh-CN: 高血糖高渗状态：血糖超过33.3 mmol/L，又有多年大量饮水，尿酮体只有++，酸中毒主要是脱水所致
text.en: Hyperglycaemic hyperosmolar state: the glucose is above 33.3 mmol/L after years of heavy drinking, ketonuria is only ++, and the acidosis mostly reflects dehydration

feedback.zh-CN: 高血糖高渗状态要求酸中毒很轻（ISPAD 2022：静脉pH高于7.25、HCO₃⁻高于15 mmol/L）、酮体很少并有明显高渗；他pH 7.21、HCO₃⁻ 4.2 mmol/L、尿酮体++，有效渗透压约271 mOsm/kg，并不高渗。这是酮症酸中毒。
feedback.en: HHS needs little acidosis (ISPAD 2022: venous pH above 7.25 and bicarbonate above 15 mmol/L), little ketosis and marked hyperosmolality; his pH of 7.21, bicarbonate of 4.2 mmol/L, ketonuria ++ and effective osmolality of about 271 mOsm/kg fit none of these. This is ketoacidosis.

text.zh-CN: 习惯性大量饮水造成的水中毒和低钠血症，加上呕吐引起的脱水；血糖升高是应激反应，补液后就会下降
text.en: Water intoxication with hyponatraemia from habitual heavy drinking, plus dehydration from the vomiting; the high glucose is a stress response that fluids will bring down

feedback.zh-CN: 水中毒解释不了酮尿和阴离子间隙35.6 mmol/L的代谢性酸中毒，应激性高血糖也不会达到38.74 mmol/L并伴酮症。多年“喝水太多”的标签恰恰可能掩盖高血糖；先按DKA处理。
feedback.en: Water intoxication explains neither the ketonuria nor an acidosis with an anion gap of 35.6 mmol/L, and stress hyperglycaemia does not reach 38.74 mmol/L with ketosis. Years of a “drinks too much” label are exactly what can hide hyperglycaemia; treat this as DKA.

prompt.zh-CN: 重度DKA。心率 102 次/分，血压 95/60 mmHg，末梢凉，皮肤黏膜干燥，呼吸深长；神志清楚但精神萎靡；钾 4.0 mmol/L。最初几个小时怎么处理？
prompt.en: Severe DKA. Heart rate 102/min, blood pressure 95/60 mmHg, cool peripheries, dry skin and mucous membranes, deep breathing; awake but listless; potassium 4.0 mmol/L. How do you manage the first hours?

need.zh-CN: 先完成决策 1，并检查他的神志、脱水程度、呼吸和末梢循环。
need.en: Answer decision 1 and examine his alertness, hydration, breathing and peripheral perfusion first.

text.zh-CN: 0.9%氯化钠10 mL/kg于30分钟输入，余下累积损失在48小时内补足；补液1小时以上后胰岛素0.05–0.1 U/kg/h输注、不推注；补液加钾40 mmol/L；不用碳酸氢钠；每小时观察神经系统
text.en: 0.9% saline 10 mL/kg over 30 minutes, then the deficit over 48 hours; insulin 0.05–0.1 unit/kg/h from an hour or more after fluids, no bolus; potassium 40 mmol/L in the fluids; no bicarbonate; hourly neuro checks

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。他脱水、末梢凉但没有休克：NICE NG18（2020年更新）和BSPED 2021给0.9%氯化钠10 mL/kg、30分钟输完，余下的累积损失加维持量在48小时内匀速补足（ISPAD 2022：24–48小时）。胰岛素在补液开始1小时以上后以0.05–0.1 U/kg/h输注、不推注；血钾4.0 mmol/L，补钾随胰岛素开始。ISPAD 2022不推荐碳酸氢钠；HCO₃⁻低是加强观察的理由，而不是补碱的理由。
feedback.en: Right. He is dehydrated with cool peripheries but not shocked: NICE NG18 (2020 update) and BSPED 2021 give 0.9% sodium chloride 10 mL/kg over 30 minutes and replace the rest of the deficit plus maintenance evenly over 48 hours (ISPAD 2022: 24–48 hours). Insulin runs at 0.05–0.1 unit/kg/h from at least an hour after the fluids start, with no bolus; with a potassium of 4.0 mmol/L, potassium starts with the insulin. ISPAD 2022 does not recommend bicarbonate; the low bicarbonate is a reason for closer observation, not for alkali.

text.zh-CN: 立即静推胰岛素0.1 U/kg，再按0.1 U/kg/h输注；0.9%氯化钠按20 mL/kg/h快速输入，直到尿量恢复正常，尽快把血糖和酮体降下来
text.en: IV insulin 0.1 unit/kg now, then 0.1 unit/kg/h; 0.9% saline at 20 mL/kg/h until his urine output is normal, to bring the glucose and ketones down as fast as possible

feedback.zh-CN: 儿童不推注胰岛素：NICE NG18和BSPED 2021明确不给负荷量，ISPAD 2022把补液第1小时内用胰岛素列为脑水肿的危险因素；目标是平稳纠正，而不是越快越好。补液也不以尿量为终点——高血糖本身就造成渗透性利尿，他多年多尿的原因也还不清楚。
feedback.en: No insulin bolus in children: NICE NG18 and BSPED 2021 advise against a loading dose, and ISPAD 2022 counts insulin in the first hour of fluids among the risk factors for cerebral oedema; the aim is steady correction, not speed. Nor is urine output the end point for fluids — hyperglycaemia keeps him in osmotic diuresis, and the cause of his years of polyuria is not yet known.

text.zh-CN: 0.9%氯化钠补液、胰岛素输注和补钾照常进行，另外静脉补碳酸氢钠1–2 mmol/kg，因为HCO₃⁻只有4.2 mmol/L，酸中毒重到会抑制心肌
text.en: Saline, an insulin infusion and potassium as usual, plus IV sodium bicarbonate 1–2 mmol/kg, because a bicarbonate of 4.2 mmol/L is severe enough to depress the heart

feedback.zh-CN: ISPAD 2022只在危及生命的高钾血症，或静脉pH低于6.9且心肌收缩力受损时才考虑碳酸氢钠；他pH 7.21、钾4.0 mmol/L。Glaser 2001发现碳酸氢钠与儿童DKA脑水肿相关（相对危险度4.2），它还会降低血钾。酸中毒随补液和胰岛素纠正。
feedback.en: ISPAD 2022 keeps bicarbonate for life-threatening hyperkalaemia or venous pH below 6.9 with impaired cardiac contractility; his pH is 7.21 and potassium 4.0 mmol/L. In Glaser 2001 bicarbonate was associated with cerebral oedema in children with DKA (relative risk 4.2), and it lowers potassium. Fluids and insulin correct the acidosis.

text.zh-CN: 先用0.9%氯化钠慢慢把血钠纠正到130 mmol/L以上再开始胰岛素，免得血糖下降时血钠和渗透压跟着骤降，引发脑水肿
text.en: Bring the sodium above 130 mmol/L slowly with 0.9% saline before starting insulin, so that the falling glucose cannot drag the sodium and osmolality down into cerebral oedema

feedback.zh-CN: 推迟胰岛素会让酮症和酸中毒继续加重。正确的做法是补液，补液1小时以上后开始胰岛素输注，每2–4小时复查钠并计算校正钠：血糖下降时实测钠应当上升，校正钠不升反降是脑水肿的警示（ISPAD 2022）。
feedback.en: Delaying insulin lets the ketosis and acidosis worsen. Give fluids, start the insulin infusion an hour or more later, and recheck the sodium every 2–4 hours with the corrected value: the measured sodium should rise as the glucose falls, and a corrected sodium that fails to rise is a warning of cerebral oedema (ISPAD 2022).

prompt.zh-CN: 急性期过后血糖已经平稳，但他每天仍喝 4700–5800 mL 水，尿比重 1.000–1.005。怎样解释，下一步做什么？
prompt.en: His glucose has settled after the acute phase, but he still drinks 4,700–5,800 mL a day and his urine specific gravity is 1.000–1.005. How do you interpret this, and what next?

need.zh-CN: 先完成决策 2，并查看病房的出入量记录和血糖平稳后的尿检结果。
need.en: Answer decision 2 and read the ward intake chart and the urine results after the glucose settled first.

text.zh-CN: 血糖已解释不了的低渗性多尿：尿崩症或原发性多饮；先配对查血钠和血、尿渗透压，再在住院监护下做禁水–去氨加压素试验
text.en: Dilute polyuria the glucose no longer explains — diabetes insipidus or primary polydipsia: pair plasma sodium and osmolality with urine osmolality, then a supervised water-deprivation–desmopressin test

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。血糖平稳后尿比重仍只有1.000–1.005，是稀释性的水利尿，不是渗透性利尿。下一步区分加压素缺乏、加压素抵抗和原发性多饮：先配对测血钠、血和尿渗透压，再在住院监护下做禁水–去氨加压素试验，监测体重和血钠并设好终止标准（Patti 2022）；在此之前不限水。
feedback.en: Right. A specific gravity of 1.000–1.005 once the glucose has settled means a water diuresis, not an osmotic one. The next step separates vasopressin deficiency, vasopressin resistance and primary polydipsia: paired plasma sodium and plasma and urine osmolality, then a supervised inpatient water-deprivation–desmopressin test with weights, sodium and stopping rules (Patti 2022) — and no restriction before it.

text.zh-CN: 仍是血糖控制不够造成的渗透性利尿：加大胰岛素剂量，直到尿量降到正常为止；尿比重低只是因为他喝水太多，不必再做别的检查
text.en: Still an osmotic diuresis from inadequate glucose control: increase the insulin until the urine volume falls to normal; the low specific gravity just reflects how much he drinks, so no further tests are needed

feedback.zh-CN: 渗透性利尿时尿里有大量葡萄糖，尿比重应偏高，而不是1.000–1.005。血糖平稳后仍是稀释尿，说明另有尿浓缩障碍或原发性多饮；加大胰岛素解决不了，还增加低血糖风险。下一步是配对的血、尿渗透压和有监护的试验（Patti 2022）。
feedback.en: An osmotic diuresis carries glucose into the urine and gives a high, not a 1.000–1.005, specific gravity. Dilute urine with a settled glucose means a concentrating defect or primary polydipsia; more insulin will not fix it and risks hypoglycaemia. Paired plasma and urine osmolality and a supervised test come next (Patti 2022).

text.zh-CN: 就是多年来一直怀疑的习惯性多饮：回家后把每天饮水限制在2升左右，慢慢改掉这个习惯，门诊随访时再看尿量有没有减少
text.en: The habitual polydipsia suspected for years: limit him to about 2 litres a day at home to break the habit, and see in clinic whether his urine volume has come down

feedback.zh-CN: 如果他是尿崩症，不论喝多少都会继续排出大量稀释尿，在家限水会很快造成危及生命的高钠性脱水。禁水只能作为住院监护下的试验来做（Patti 2022）；在弄清原因之前，必须保证他随时能喝到水。
feedback.en: If he has diabetes insipidus he will keep passing large volumes of dilute urine whatever he drinks, and restriction at home can quickly cause life-threatening hypernatraemic dehydration. Water deprivation is done only as a supervised inpatient test (Patti 2022); until the cause is clear he must always be able to drink.

text.zh-CN: 直接用足量去氨加压素，同时限制饮水以防低钠：用药后尿量明显减少就说明是中枢性尿崩症，用不着再做禁水试验
text.en: Start full-dose desmopressin now with fluid restriction to prevent hyponatraemia: if his urine volume falls, that proves central diabetes insipidus, and no deprivation test is needed

feedback.zh-CN: 试用去氨加压素代替不了有监护的试验：原发性多饮的孩子会继续大量喝水，用药后可能发生水中毒，而他入院时的血钠本就偏低；限水又会在加压素抵抗时造成高钠。先通过检查明确类型再用药（Patti 2022）。
feedback.en: A desmopressin trial is no substitute for a supervised test: a child with primary polydipsia keeps drinking and can become water-intoxicated on it, and his sodium was already low on admission, while restriction would make him hypernatraemic if he has vasopressin resistance. Establish the type by testing before treating (Patti 2022).

prompt.zh-CN: 他的糖尿病以DKA起病，GADA和IAA阴性；血糖平稳后仍是稀释性多尿，对加压素反应差；眼底见视神经萎缩；听力为高频感音神经性听力下降；影像示双肾积水、输尿管扩张，他尿尿费劲。最好的综合判断是？
prompt.en: His diabetes presented in DKA with negative GADA and IAA; once the glucose settled he still had dilute polyuria with a poor response to vasopressin; fundoscopy shows optic atrophy; his hearing shows high-frequency sensorineural loss; imaging shows bilateral hydronephrosis and ureteric dilatation, and he struggles to pass urine. What is the best synthesis?

need.zh-CN: 先完成决策 3；调阅加压素试验、听力报告、泌尿系影像和胰岛自身抗体，查看眼底，并问清排尿情况。
need.en: Answer decision 3; read the vasopressin test, the hearing report, the urinary tract imaging and the islet antibodies, examine his fundi and ask how he passes urine.

text.zh-CN: 临床诊断Wolfram综合征：16岁前糖尿病加视神经萎缩，伴尿崩症、耳聋和尿路扩张；查WFS1、做头颅垂体MRI，尿崩症类型尚未证实
text.en: Clinical Wolfram syndrome: diabetes and optic atrophy before 16 with diabetes insipidus, deafness and a dilated urinary tract; test WFS1, image brain and pituitary, and treat the diabetes insipidus type as unproven

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。GeneReviews（2023年更新）以16岁前出现的糖尿病和视神经萎缩为经典WFS1谱系疾病的特征，尿崩症、感音神经性耳聋和神经源性膀胱是常见伴随表现；抗体阴性的糖尿病伴胰外表现应做基因检测（ISPAD 2022单基因糖尿病指南）。双等位WFS1致病变异才能确诊；头颅和垂体MRI仍要做，既看该综合征的脑部改变，也排除鞍区病变。单凭“对加压素反应差”定不了尿崩症的类型。
feedback.en: Right. GeneReviews (updated 2023) defines classic WFS1 spectrum disorder by diabetes and optic atrophy before 16 years, with diabetes insipidus, sensorineural deafness and neurogenic bladder as common companions, and antibody-negative diabetes with extra-pancreatic features calls for genetic testing (ISPAD 2022 monogenic diabetes). Biallelic pathogenic WFS1 variants confirm it, and brain and pituitary MRI is still needed — for the brain changes of the syndrome and to exclude a sellar lesion. A “poor response to vasopressin” alone does not settle the type of diabetes insipidus.

text.zh-CN: 1型糖尿病合并另一种独立的肾性尿崩症：加压素反应差已证明是肾性；视神经和听力改变是多年未诊断糖尿病的并发症，不需要做基因检测
text.en: Type 1 diabetes plus a separate nephrogenic diabetes insipidus, proven by the poor vasopressin response; the optic and hearing changes are complications of years of undiagnosed diabetes, so no genetic test is needed

feedback.zh-CN: 视神经萎缩不是糖尿病的并发症（糖尿病眼病是视网膜病变），多年未诊断的糖尿病也解释不了尿崩症和高频听力下降。GADA和IAA阴性、16岁前糖尿病合并视神经萎缩，指向需要基因确认的单一综合征（GeneReviews 2023）；“反应差”也证明不了是肾性。
feedback.en: Optic atrophy is not a complication of diabetes (diabetic eye disease is retinopathy), and undiagnosed diabetes explains neither the diabetes insipidus nor high-frequency hearing loss. Negative GADA and IAA with diabetes and optic atrophy before 16 point to one syndrome needing genetic confirmation (GeneReviews 2023); a “poor response” does not prove a nephrogenic cause either.

text.zh-CN: 母系遗传的线粒体糖尿病伴耳聋（m.3243A>G）：糖尿病加感音神经性耳聋就够诊断了；查母亲的线粒体DNA，尿崩症和眼底改变另当别论
text.en: Maternally inherited diabetes and deafness (m.3243A>G): diabetes with sensorineural deafness is enough; test his mother's mitochondrial DNA and treat the diabetes insipidus and optic findings as separate

feedback.zh-CN: 母系遗传线粒体糖尿病伴耳聋可以有糖尿病和感音神经性耳聋，但不会引起尿崩症，视神经萎缩也不是它的特征。16岁前糖尿病合并视神经萎缩首先指向WFS1谱系疾病（GeneReviews 2023），ISPAD 2022也主张用多基因测序，而不是逐个猜基因。
feedback.en: Maternally inherited diabetes and deafness gives diabetes and sensorineural deafness but not diabetes insipidus, and optic atrophy is not its feature. Diabetes with optic atrophy before 16 points first to WFS1 spectrum disorder (GeneReviews 2023), and ISPAD 2022 favours multi-gene sequencing over single-gene guesses.

text.zh-CN: 鞍上占位（如颅咽管瘤）压迫视交叉和垂体柄，能解释尿崩症和视神经萎缩；糖尿病和耳聋只是巧合，先请神经外科处理占位
text.en: A suprasellar lesion such as a craniopharyngioma compressing the chiasm and stalk explains the diabetes insipidus and optic atrophy; the diabetes and deafness are coincidental, so refer to neurosurgery first

feedback.zh-CN: 鞍区占位确实可以引起中枢性尿崩症和视力损害，所以MRI要做；但它解释不了抗体阴性的糖尿病、高频感音神经性耳聋和尿路扩张。先找能解释全部发现的一个诊断（GeneReviews 2023），MRI作为同一次评估的一部分（Patti 2022）。
feedback.en: A sellar lesion can cause central diabetes insipidus and visual loss, which is why the MRI is needed; but it explains neither antibody-negative diabetes, nor high-frequency sensorineural deafness, nor the dilated urinary tract. Look for the one diagnosis that explains every finding (GeneReviews 2023), with the MRI part of the same work-up (Patti 2022).

prompt.zh-CN: 他双肾积水、输尿管扩张，尿尿费劲，每天仍排出大量尿液；目前是临床诊断，基因结果还没有。现阶段哪一项计划最能保护他？
prompt.en: He has bilateral hydronephrosis and ureteric dilatation, struggles to pass urine and still passes large volumes every day; the diagnosis is clinical, with no genetic result yet. At this point, which plan protects him best?

text.zh-CN: 现在就测残余尿和肾功能、转泌尿外科做尿动力学，排空不全时间歇导尿；随时饮水加书面应急方案；胰岛素教育；眼科、听力、遗传和心理随访
text.en: Residual volume and renal function now, urodynamics, intermittent catheterisation if he does not empty; free access to water with a written plan; insulin education; eye, hearing, genetic and psychological care

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。尿路扩张加排尿困难提示膀胱可能排空不全：EAU/ESPU 2020神经源性膀胱指南要求评估排空并做尿动力学，残余尿多时用清洁间歇导尿保护上尿路（用于本综合征属于外推）。尿崩症的孩子必须随时能喝到水，呕吐或不能饮水时要尽早静脉补液并查血钠。SID/SIEDP 2025共识主张多学科、身心兼顾的长期照护：眼科、听力、遗传咨询、神经和心理。
feedback.en: Right. A dilated urinary tract with voiding difficulty suggests a bladder that may not empty: the EAU/ESPU 2020 neurogenic bladder guideline asks for emptying assessment and urodynamics, with clean intermittent catheterisation to protect the upper tracts when the residual is high (an extrapolation to this syndrome). A child with diabetes insipidus must always be able to drink, and needs early IV fluids with sodium checks when vomiting or unable to drink. The SID/SIEDP 2025 consensus asks for multidisciplinary care of body and mind: eyes, hearing, genetic counselling, neurology and psychology.

text.zh-CN: 用氢氯噻嗪减少尿量，胰岛素控制血糖；尿量少了以后肾积水自然会慢慢好转，所以暂时不必查膀胱，门诊定期复查超声、看积水有没有减轻就行
text.en: Reduce the urine volume with hydrochlorothiazide and control the glucose with insulin; with less urine flowing, the hydronephrosis will settle, so no bladder tests are needed yet — just repeat the ultrasound in clinic

feedback.zh-CN: 报告记录他稳定后用了胰岛素和氢氯噻嗪，这本身可以是合理的选择；但排尿困难合并双肾积水时，不能假定扩张只是尿量大所致——排空不全会持续损害上尿路。先测残余尿和肾功能，再做尿动力学（EAU/ESPU 2020）。
feedback.en: The report records insulin and hydrochlorothiazide after he stabilised, which can be reasonable in itself; but with voiding difficulty and bilateral hydronephrosis you cannot assume the dilatation is only high flow — incomplete emptying keeps damaging the upper tracts. Measure the residual and renal function, then urodynamics (EAU/ESPU 2020).

text.zh-CN: 限制每天饮水量，减少流经扩张的肾脏和膀胱的尿量，以保护尿路；每周查一次血钠，血钠升高时再适当放宽
text.en: Restrict his daily fluid intake to cut the urine flow through the dilated kidneys and bladder; check his sodium weekly and relax the limit if it rises

feedback.zh-CN: 限水对尿浓缩障碍的孩子很危险：他仍会排出大量稀释尿，结果是高钠性脱水，而不是保护肾脏；每周查一次血钠远远不够。保护尿路靠的是让膀胱排空（EAU/ESPU 2020），不是少喝水。
feedback.en: Restriction is dangerous for a child who cannot concentrate urine: he keeps passing dilute urine and becomes hypernatraemic and dry instead of protecting his kidneys, and a weekly sodium is nowhere near enough. The urinary tract is protected by emptying the bladder (EAU/ESPU 2020), not by drinking less.

text.zh-CN: 先等基因检测结果出来再安排各专科，免得诊断不成立时让家庭白白担心；出院时只交代测血糖和打胰岛素
text.en: Wait for the genetic result before arranging specialist care, so the family is not alarmed by a diagnosis that may not hold; at discharge, teach only glucose checks and insulin

feedback.zh-CN: 膀胱、视力和听力的问题现在就存在，不会因为等基因结果而停下来；基因检测确认诊断、指导遗传咨询，但不决定这些问题要不要处理。SID/SIEDP 2025共识主张尽早进行多学科评估；不确定的地方要和家庭坦诚说明。
feedback.en: The bladder, sight and hearing problems exist now and will not wait for a genetic result; the test confirms the diagnosis and guides counselling but does not decide whether these need care. The SID/SIEDP 2025 consensus asks for early multidisciplinary assessment, and the uncertainty is discussed honestly with the family.

text.zh-CN: 问清七年来的饮水和尿量、以往的判断和治疗（以及现在是否还在用加压素）、这三天的呕吐、既往头部外伤/头痛/昏迷史、父母健康与近亲婚配情况和排尿情况
text.en: Took the seven-year drinking and urine pattern, earlier labels and treatment (and current vasopressin use), the three days of vomiting, past head injury, headache or coma, parents' health and consanguinity, and voiding

text.zh-CN: 检查神志和体型、心率血压、脱水体征、呼吸方式和末梢循环，并在病房查看眼底
text.en: Examined alertness and build, pulse and blood pressure, hydration, breathing pattern and peripheral perfusion, and the fundi on the ward

text.zh-CN: 入院时查血糖、尿常规、血气和电解质并申请血酮和肾功能；病房查看出入量和尿比重；随后调阅加压素试验、听力报告和泌尿系影像
text.en: Checked glucose, urinalysis, gas and electrolytes with blood ketones and renal function on admission, the intake chart and urine specific gravity on the ward, then the vasopressin test, hearing report and urinary tract imaging

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即判断为重度DKA并识别真性低钠（决策 1）
text.en: Graded severe DKA and recognised true hyponatraemia at the first attempt (decision 1)

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择先补液、后胰岛素输注、补钾且不用碳酸氢钠的方案（决策 2）
text.en: Chose fluids first, then an insulin infusion with potassium and no bicarbonate, at the first attempt (decision 2)

text.zh-CN: 入院阶段及时完成：0.9%氯化钠初始补液，之后才开始胰岛素持续输注，并在看过血钾后开始含钾补液
text.en: In the admission phase: gave the 0.9% sodium chloride bolus, started the insulin infusion only after it, and began potassium-containing fluids once the potassium was known

text.zh-CN: 没有推注胰岛素、没有用碳酸氢钠、没有让他限制饮水，也没有在监护下的试验之前就用去氨加压素
text.en: Gave no insulin bolus and no bicarbonate, never restricted his drinking, and started no desmopressin before the supervised test

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即识别血糖平稳后的低渗性多尿，并选择有监护的试验（决策 3）
text.en: Recognised hypotonic polyuria after glucose control and chose a supervised test, at the first attempt (decision 3)

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即做出能解释全部发现的综合判断，并说明证据的局限（决策 4）
text.en: Made the synthesis that explains every finding and named its limits, at the first attempt (decision 4)

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择优先保护尿路和饮水安全的多学科计划（决策 5）
text.en: Chose the multidisciplinary plan that protects the urinary tract and water access first, at the first attempt (decision 5)

text.zh-CN: 完成关键处置：静脉通路、监护、高依赖病房、每小时观察计划、禁水–加压素试验、膀胱排空评估与泌尿外科、随时饮水方案、胰岛素自我管理教育、专科随访和遗传咨询
text.en: Carried out the keyed care: IV access, monitoring, high-dependency care, the hourly observation plan, the water-deprivation–vasopressin test, bladder assessment and urology, the water-access plan, insulin education, specialist follow-up and genetic counselling

text.zh-CN: 向他本人和家人说明诊断、不确定性和安全要点，并核实理解
text.en: Explained the diagnosis, its uncertainty and the safety points to him and his family, and checked understanding

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 按Calgary–Cambridge结构，告知这一可能为进行性的遗传综合征时用SPIKES：选安静的地方，先单独问他希望怎样谈，再和家人一起谈；先了解他们已经知道什么、最担心什么（是不是很重、渴了能不能喝）；用通俗的话分步说明：起病时的酮症酸中毒已经控制，糖尿病需要长期用胰岛素；持续多尿是另一个问题；眼睛、听力和排尿的发现可能属于同一个综合征——目前是临床诊断，需要基因检测确认，尿崩症的类型也还没有证实；把安全要点讲清楚：想喝就喝、绝不能自行限水，呕吐或喝不下水要尽快就医，以及生病期间的胰岛素规则；说明遗传方式和家里其他人的检测会在遗传咨询中讨论；不承诺“很快会好”，也不回避预后问题；给他表达感受的时间，提供心理支持；用回授法确认理解，并讲清随访安排。
judgeGuidance.en: Calgary–Cambridge structure, with SPIKES for sharing a possibly progressive genetic diagnosis: a quiet setting; ask him first, privately, how he would like it done, then talk with his family together; find out what they know and fear most (whether it is serious, whether he may drink when thirsty); explain step by step in plain words — the ketoacidosis at presentation is under control and the diabetes needs lifelong insulin; the continuing polyuria is a separate problem; the eye, hearing and bladder findings may belong to one syndrome, a clinical diagnosis that needs genetic confirmation, and the type of diabetes insipidus is not yet proven; give the safety messages clearly — drink whenever thirsty and never restrict water, seek care early when vomiting or unable to drink, and the sick-day insulin rules; say that inheritance and testing of relatives belong in genetic counselling; promise no quick recovery but do not evade questions about the future; leave room for feelings and offer psychological support; check understanding by teach-back and explain the follow-up.

name.zh-CN: 温医生（儿科内分泌主治医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教，按PEARLS引导，只围绕学员已经获得的资料提问。要引导出的推理：多年“喝水太多”的标签为什么不能代替查血糖和尿酮；pH和HCO₃⁻不一致时按哪一项分级；怎样按血糖校正血钠、计算有效渗透压，这些数字对补液和脑水肿风险意味着什么；为什么先补液、补液1小时以上后才开始胰岛素输注而且不推注，血钾正常时补钾何时开始；为什么不用碳酸氢钠；血糖平稳后尿仍很稀说明什么，为什么禁水只能在住院监护下作为试验来做；能否找到一个诊断解释学员收集到的全部发现，为什么仍需要基因检测和MRI；排尿困难合并尿路扩张时为什么要马上评估膀胱排空；怎样与这个13岁的孩子和他的家人谈一个可能进行性的诊断。历史与现行：到复盘时，再把报告记录的处理与ISPAD 2022、NICE NG18和GeneReviews 2023逐项对照。病例没有记录的内容（体温、呼吸频率、血氧、PaCO₂、氯、尿素和肌酐、血酮、各次复查值、加压素试验的数据、视力和听阈、残余尿、MRI、基因结果、兄弟姐妹、学校和心情）不要替它补上。学员作答前，不说出诊断、任何决策的正确选项或报告的处理与结局。
knowledge.en: A Socratic teacher using PEARLS who asks only about information the learner already has. Reasoning to draw out: why years of a “drinks too much” label never replace a glucose and urine ketone check; which of pH and bicarbonate sets the grade when they disagree; how to correct the sodium for glucose and work out the effective osmolality, and what those numbers mean for fluids and cerebral oedema risk; why fluids come first and the insulin infusion only an hour or more later with no bolus, and when potassium starts if it is normal; why no bicarbonate; what persistently dilute urine with a settled glucose means, and why water deprivation is only ever a supervised inpatient test; whether one diagnosis explains everything the learner has found, and why genetic testing and MRI are still needed; why voiding difficulty with a dilated urinary tract needs a bladder-emptying assessment now; how to talk with this 13-year-old and his family about a possibly progressive diagnosis. Then and now: in the debrief, compare the report's recorded management point by point with ISPAD 2022, NICE NG18 and GeneReviews 2023. Never supply what the case does not record (temperature, breathing rate, oxygen saturation, PaCO₂, chloride, urea and creatinine, blood ketones, repeat values, the vasopressin test data, visual acuity and hearing thresholds, residual volume, MRI, genetic results, siblings, school and mood). Before the learner commits, never state the diagnosis, any decision's correct option, or the report's management and outcome.

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿科病房护士。交班（ISBAR）：13岁男孩，家属陪同；多饮多尿7年，近3天呕吐逐渐加重，进食即吐，精神越来越差；入院时神志清楚、精神萎靡，心率102次/分，血压95/60 mmHg。病区有治疗车和抢救车（静脉置管用物）、输液泵、监护仪、床旁血糖仪和药柜；病历和化验报告在护士站电脑上调阅。复述医嘱，严格记录出入量；只报告已经回报的结果，不解读、不诊断；被问到病例没有记录的内容（体温、呼吸频率、血氧饱和度、身高、之后的观察数值）时，如实说没有记录。
knowledge.en: Children's ward nurse. Handover (ISBAR): 13-year-old boy with a relative; seven years of heavy drinking and urination, three days of worsening vomiting after meals, increasingly listless; on admission awake but listless, heart rate 102/min, blood pressure 95/60 mmHg. The ward has treatment and crash trolleys (cannulation kit), infusion pumps, monitors, a bedside glucose meter and a drug cupboard; notes and lab reports are on the nurses' station computer. Reads orders back and keeps a strict fluid balance chart; reports only results that are back and never interprets or diagnoses; asked about anything the case does not record (temperature, breathing rate, oxygen saturation, height, later observations), says plainly that it is not recorded.

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿科临床药师，只解读学员已经调阅的资料。可以讲：儿童胰岛素持续输注的配制（如普通胰岛素50单位加0.9%氯化钠至50 mL，即1单位/mL）和0.05–0.1 U/kg/h的速度，不推注；补液中氯化钾40 mmol/L，无尿或高钾时暂缓；碳酸氢钠的适应证（ISPAD 2022：危及生命的高钾血症，或静脉pH低于6.9伴心肌收缩力受损）和风险；甘露醇或高渗盐水按体重预先算好放在床旁；去氨加压素可致水潴留和低钠，用药期间要有饮水建议并监测血钠；噻嗪类在加压素抵抗时可以减少尿量，但可致低钠、低钾并影响血糖。不替病例补充任何没有记录的剂量或数值。
knowledge.en: Paediatric clinical pharmacist who interprets only what the learner has already read. Can explain: making up a paediatric insulin infusion (for example 50 units of soluble insulin made up to 50 mL with 0.9% sodium chloride, 1 unit/mL) at 0.05–0.1 unit/kg/h with no bolus; potassium chloride 40 mmol/L in the fluids, held while anuric or hyperkalaemic; the indications for bicarbonate (ISPAD 2022: life-threatening hyperkalaemia, or venous pH below 6.9 with impaired cardiac contractility) and its risks; mannitol or hypertonic saline calculated for weight in advance and kept at the bedside; desmopressin causing water retention and hyponatraemia, so it needs drinking advice and sodium checks; thiazides reducing urine volume in vasopressin resistance but causing low sodium and potassium and affecting glucose. Never supplies a dose or value the case does not record.

knowledge.zh-CN: 超声科医生，只解读学员已经调阅的影像，不提前说出结果。可以讲：尿量很大的孩子出现尿路扩张，可能是高流量本身，也可能是膀胱排空障碍、膀胱出口问题或反流，需要排尿前后的膀胱图像和残余尿量来区分；肾实质厚度和回声、膀胱壁厚度对判断很重要；病例没有记录的细节不能补写。头颅和垂体MRI在本病例没有结果记录。
knowledge.en: Ultrasound doctor who interprets only imaging the learner has already read and never gives results in advance. Can explain: in a child passing very large volumes, a dilated urinary tract may reflect the high flow itself or a bladder that does not empty, an outlet problem or reflux, which pre- and post-void bladder views and the residual volume tell apart; renal parenchymal thickness and echogenicity and bladder wall thickness matter; details the case does not record must not be filled in. No brain or pituitary MRI result is recorded in this case.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：以重度酮症酸中毒起病的Wolfram综合征
title.en: Debrief: Wolfram syndrome presenting with severe diabetic ketoacidosis

conclusion.zh-CN: 一个极度消瘦的13岁男孩七年来每天喝水4200–6000 mL、尿量相近，一直被认为是精神性多饮或尿崩症。呕吐3天后他精神萎靡、脱水、呼吸深长：血糖38.74 mmol/L，尿酮体++，pH 7.21，HCO₃⁻ 4.2 mmol/L，阴离子间隙35.6 mmol/L，钠116 mmol/L（校正约128），GADA和IAA阴性——重度DKA。血糖平稳后他每天仍喝4700–5800 mL水（尿比重1.000–1.005），对加压素反应差，并有视神经萎缩、高频感音神经性听力下降、双肾积水、输尿管扩张和排尿困难。报告临床诊断为Wolfram综合征，没有基因结果；之后用胰岛素和氢氯噻嗪，约2周出院，一年内两次随访稳定。今天的做法：先补液再开胰岛素输注，不推注、不补碱；禁水只在监护下作为试验，平时绝不限水；做WFS1检测和MRI，并及早处理膀胱排空。
conclusion.en: For seven years a very thin 13-year-old had drunk 4,200–6,000 mL a day, with similar urine volumes, labelled psychogenic polydipsia or diabetes insipidus. After three days of vomiting he was listless, dry and breathing deeply: glucose 38.74 mmol/L, ketonuria ++, pH 7.21, bicarbonate 4.2 mmol/L, anion gap 35.6 mmol/L, sodium 116 mmol/L (corrected about 128), GADA and IAA negative: severe DKA. With the glucose settled he still drank 4,700–5,800 mL a day (urine specific gravity 1.000–1.005) and responded poorly to vasopressin; he had optic atrophy, high-frequency sensorineural hearing loss, bilateral hydronephrosis, ureteric dilatation and voiding difficulty. The report diagnosed Wolfram syndrome clinically, with no genetic result; insulin and hydrochlorothiazide followed, discharge at about two weeks, stable at two visits within a year. Today: fluids before an insulin infusion, no bolus or bicarbonate; supervised water testing, never restriction; WFS1, MRI, early bladder care.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 一个多年多饮多尿的孩子出现呕吐和精神萎靡，先查血糖和酮体：“喝水太多”的旧标签解释不了酮症酸中毒。
keyReasoning.en: Vomiting and listlessness in a child with years of polyuria call for a glucose and ketone check first: an old “drinks too much” label cannot explain ketoacidosis.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: pH和HCO₃⁻不一致时按较重的一项分级；把血钠按血糖校正，看清他就诊时的脑水肿危险因素。
keyReasoning.en: When pH and bicarbonate disagree, the worse one sets the grade; correct the sodium for glucose and name the cerebral oedema risk factors he arrives with.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 顺序决定安全：先等渗补液，补液1小时以上后胰岛素持续输注、不推注，血钾正常时补钾随胰岛素开始，不补碱。
keyReasoning.en: Order makes it safe: isotonic fluid first, an insulin infusion an hour or more later with no bolus, potassium with the insulin when it is normal, and no alkali.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 血糖平稳后尿仍很稀是另一个问题：区分尿浓缩障碍和原发性多饮，只在监护下检查。
keyReasoning.en: Dilute urine once the glucose has settled is a separate problem: tell a concentrating defect from primary polydipsia, testing only under supervision.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 抗体阴性的糖尿病、视神经萎缩、尿崩症、耳聋和尿路扩张同时出现时，寻找一个统一的诊断，再用基因和影像去确认。
keyReasoning.en: When antibody-negative diabetes, optic atrophy, diabetes insipidus, deafness and a dilated urinary tract occur together, look for one unifying diagnosis, then confirm it with genetics and imaging.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 现在就威胁器官的问题（膀胱排空、上尿路、饮水安全）不必等基因结果。
keyReasoning.en: Problems that threaten organs now — bladder emptying, the upper tracts, safe access to water — do not wait for the genetic result.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 分级与数值：ISPAD 2022按pH或HCO₃⁻分级——轻度pH＜7.3或HCO₃⁻＜18 mmol/L，中度＜7.2或＜10，重度＜7.1或＜5；他的pH 7.21单看属轻度，HCO₃⁻ 4.2 mmol/L则为重度。校正钠＝116＋2×［(38.74－5.6)/5.6］≈128 mmol/L，低钠是真性的；有效渗透压＝2×116＋38.74≈271 mOsm/kg。另按Henderson–Hasselbalch方程，pH 7.21与HCO₃⁻ 4.2 mmol/L对应的PaCO₂约11 mmHg，已接近呼吸代偿的极限——这两个数值是否来自同一份标本需要核实。
teachingPoints.en: Grading and numbers: ISPAD 2022 grades by pH or bicarbonate — mild pH < 7.3 or bicarbonate < 18 mmol/L, moderate < 7.2 or < 10, severe < 7.1 or < 5 — so his pH of 7.21 alone reads as mild while a bicarbonate of 4.2 mmol/L is severe. The corrected sodium, 116 + 2 × [(38.74 − 5.6)/5.6], is about 128 mmol/L: true hyponatraemia; the effective osmolality, 2 × 116 + 38.74, is about 271 mOsm/kg. By Henderson–Hasselbalch, a pH of 7.21 with a bicarbonate of 4.2 mmol/L implies a PaCO₂ of about 11 mmHg, near the limit of respiratory compensation — whether the two values came from one sample needs checking.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 最初几个小时（历史与现行）：本病例只记录了“急救后稳定”，没有补液和剂量。现行做法：没有休克时0.9%氯化钠10 mL/kg、30分钟输完，余下的累积损失加维持量在48小时内补足，补液中加氯化钾40 mmol/L（NICE NG18 2020年更新；BSPED 2021，见Rugg-Gunn 2021；ISPAD 2022为24–48小时）；胰岛素0.05–0.1 U/kg/h在补液开始1小时以上后输注，不推注。
teachingPoints.en: The first hours, then and now: this case records only “stabilised after emergency care”, with no fluids or doses. Current practice: without shock, 0.9% sodium chloride 10 mL/kg over 30 minutes, the remaining deficit plus maintenance over 48 hours with potassium chloride 40 mmol/L in the fluids (NICE NG18 2020 update; BSPED 2021, as harmonised by Rugg-Gunn 2021; ISPAD 2022: 24–48 hours), and insulin 0.05–0.1 unit/kg/h from at least an hour after the fluids start, with no bolus.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 碳酸氢钠与脑水肿：ISPAD 2022只在危及生命的高钾血症或静脉pH＜6.9伴心肌收缩力受损时考虑碳酸氢钠。Glaser 2001（NEJM）发现，就诊时PaCO₂低、尿素氮高与儿童DKA脑水肿相关，在各项治疗中只有碳酸氢钠与之相关（相对危险度4.2）。他HCO₃⁻很低，需要的是高依赖病房的每小时神经系统观察、追踪校正钠，以及床旁备好甘露醇或高渗盐水，而不是补碱。
teachingPoints.en: Bicarbonate and cerebral oedema: ISPAD 2022 keeps bicarbonate for life-threatening hyperkalaemia or venous pH < 6.9 with impaired cardiac contractility. In Glaser 2001 (NEJM), low PaCO₂ and high urea at presentation were associated with cerebral oedema in children with DKA, and bicarbonate was the only treatment associated with it (relative risk 4.2). His very low bicarbonate calls for hourly neurological observation in a high-dependency bed, tracking of the corrected sodium and mannitol or hypertonic saline at the bedside — not for alkali.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 血糖控制后的多尿：尿比重1.000–1.005、每天饮水4700–5800 mL，是水利尿而不是渗透性利尿——需要区分加压素缺乏、加压素抵抗（2022年起中枢性、肾性尿崩症的新名称）和原发性多饮。先配对测血钠和血、尿渗透压，再在住院监护下做禁水–去氨加压素试验，并做MRI（Patti 2022）。多年多尿造成的髓质浓度梯度丧失和尿路扩张都会削弱对加压素的反应，所以单凭“反应差”说明不了病变在哪里、是原发还是继发。
teachingPoints.en: Polyuria after glucose control: a specific gravity of 1.000–1.005 with 4,700–5,800 mL drunk a day is a water diuresis, not an osmotic one — vasopressin deficiency, vasopressin resistance (the names proposed since 2022 for central and nephrogenic diabetes insipidus) or primary polydipsia. Pair plasma sodium with plasma and urine osmolality, then a supervised inpatient water-deprivation–desmopressin test with MRI (Patti 2022). Medullary washout after years of polyuria and a dilated urinary tract both blunt the response to vasopressin, so a “poor response” alone cannot show where the defect lies, or whether it is primary or secondary.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 统一诊断与遗传：GeneReviews（2023年更新）以16岁前出现的糖尿病和视神经萎缩为经典WFS1谱系疾病的特征，确诊需要双等位WFS1致病变异；ISPAD 2022单基因糖尿病指南对抗体阴性、伴胰外表现的糖尿病主张做基因检测。报告是临床诊断、没有基因结果记录；今天还要做WFS1检测（必要时CISD2）、遗传咨询和头颅垂体MRI。
teachingPoints.en: One diagnosis and its genetics: GeneReviews (updated 2023) defines classic WFS1 spectrum disorder by diabetes and optic atrophy before 16 years and confirms it with biallelic pathogenic WFS1 variants; the ISPAD 2022 monogenic diabetes guideline asks for genetic testing in antibody-negative diabetes with extra-pancreatic features. The report's diagnosis was clinical, with no genetic result recorded; today it would add WFS1 testing (CISD2 if indicated), genetic counselling and brain and pituitary MRI.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 保护尿路与长期照护：尿路扩张伴排尿困难意味着膀胱可能排空不全——测残余尿和肾功能，做尿动力学，必要时清洁间歇导尿（EAU/ESPU 2020，外推到本综合征）；尿崩症的孩子必须随时能喝水，呕吐时尽早静脉补液并查血钠；眼科、听力、神经和心理随访按SID/SIEDP 2025共识多学科进行。
teachingPoints.en: Protecting the urinary tract, and long-term care: a dilated tract with voiding difficulty means a bladder that may not empty — measure the residual and renal function, arrange urodynamics and clean intermittent catheterisation if needed (EAU/ESPU 2020, extrapolated to this syndrome); a child with diabetes insipidus must always be able to drink and needs early IV fluids with sodium checks when vomiting; eye, hearing, neurology and psychology follow-up is multidisciplinary, as the SID/SIEDP 2025 consensus asks.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单个病例报告：不能据此说明这种综合征的发生率、预后或某种治疗的效果，也不能确定尿崩症的机制。本版的患者事实沿用1.0.0版的记录，尚未对照原文全文核对。报告的处理作为历史事实记录；决策、处置选项和评分依据现行指南设计，属于教学设计。生命体征的其余数值、复查结果、试验数据、影像方法、基因结果和一年以后的病程都没有记录。
boundaries.en: This is a single case report: it cannot show how common the syndrome is, its prognosis or the effect of any treatment, nor establish the mechanism of the diabetes insipidus. The patient facts in this version are those recorded in version 1.0.0 and have not yet been checked against the full article. The report's management is recorded as historical fact; the decisions, management options and scoring follow current guidance and are teaching design. The remaining vital signs, repeat results, test data, imaging method, genetic results and the course beyond one year are not recorded.

unknowns.zh-CN: 体温、呼吸频率、血氧饱和度、毛细血管再充盈时间、意识评分和身高；27 kg是何时测得的体重。
unknowns.en: Temperature, breathing rate, oxygen saturation, capillary refill time, a conscious-level score and height; when the 27 kg weight was measured.

unknowns.zh-CN: PaCO₂、氯、血β-羟丁酸、尿素、肌酐、血渗透压、HbA1c和C肽；血糖的标本类型；pH和HCO₃⁻是否来自同一份标本。
unknowns.en: PaCO₂, chloride, blood β-hydroxybutyrate, urea, creatinine, plasma osmolality, HbA1c and C-peptide; the sample type of the glucose; whether the pH and bicarbonate came from one sample.

unknowns.zh-CN: 急性期的补液种类和量、胰岛素用法和剂量、补钾、是否用过碳酸氢钠、酮症酸中毒纠正所需时间，以及治疗中的钠和血糖变化。
unknowns.en: The acute-phase fluids and volumes, how insulin was given and at what dose, potassium, whether any bicarbonate was used, the time to resolution of the ketoacidosis, and the sodium and glucose during treatment.

unknowns.zh-CN: 加压素试验：是否先禁水、时长、体重变化、试验前后的血钠和血、尿渗透压、所用制剂和剂量；血糖平稳后的尿量。
unknowns.en: The vasopressin test: whether water deprivation came first, its duration, weight change, plasma sodium and plasma and urine osmolality before and after, the preparation and dose; urine volumes after the glucose settled.

unknowns.zh-CN: 视力、色觉和视野；听阈和左右侧；排尿后残余尿、尿动力学、肾功能，以及是哪种影像发现了肾积水。
unknowns.en: Visual acuity, colour vision and fields; hearing thresholds and sides; post-void residual, urodynamics, renal function, and which imaging showed the hydronephrosis.

unknowns.zh-CN: 头颅和垂体MRI、WFS1/CISD2基因检测、IA-2A和ZnT8A；有没有兄弟姐妹、其他亲属的病史，以及学校、家庭和情绪方面的情况。
unknowns.en: Brain and pituitary MRI, WFS1/CISD2 testing, IA-2A and ZnT8A; whether he has siblings, illness in other relatives, and his school, home and mood.

unknowns.zh-CN: 胰岛素和氢氯噻嗪的方案和剂量、两次随访时测了什么，以及一年以后的病程。
unknowns.en: The insulin and hydrochlorothiazide regimens and doses, what was measured at the two follow-up visits, and the course beyond one year.
